key_provisions_or_claims: Balance employers' legitimate monitoring interests with employee privacy through transparent policies and consent.
Current legal frameworks need updating to allocate liability for accidents caused by robots and autonomous systems.
Legislation should protect workers' rights amid automation, including retraining and alternative employment.
Employers should implement data protection measures when using robots and AI.
Regulators should collaborate with industry to develop flexible yet comprehensive regulation.
annotation.summary_en: Journal article reviewing legal implications of robots and AI in the workplace: AI surveillance and employee privacy, discrimination, automation and autonomous systems, liability, safety and insurance. Compares EU, US and ILO norms and calls for updated liability rules, worker protections and flexible regulation.
